title: Source
description: One reference in the source registry (data/sources/<id>.json). Entries cite sources by id, with an optional locator such as a page, section or verse.

id.description: Stable id, also the file name

kind.description: classical: Ayurvedic texts. pharmacopoeia: official standards. safety: government safety monographs and drug labels. paper: a peer-reviewed article (needs a PMID or DOI). database: reference databases. search: a search link, which never counts as support for a claim.

updated.description: Version or 'last updated' date as the publisher states it, for example 'February 2025'. Checked weekly for NIH fact sheets.

accessed.description: When we last read the source to check our entries against it
